CHS::confirmed::`taking_non_statin_medic.notes:
Note fibrates (C10AB) are not statins, if a "lipid-lowering medication" variable gets mapped generically, make sure fibrates land on C10AB.
ATC is the classification layer, so C10AB is the right single-concept target for a fibrate class concept, and it's the ancestor of the RxNorm fibrate ingredients (gemfibrozil, fenofibrate…) for an actual drug exposure — map the exposure to RxNorm and let C10AB serve as the rollup.
